step_4_listing.description: MUSITU Axiom provides governed quantitative finance, statistics, optimization, time-series, verification, and mathematical computation through an existing Axiom account. It is designed for reproducible analytical workflows with explicit operation boundaries and metering. The Claude connector is read-only with respect to external user systems: it does not execute trades, transfer money, expose subscription checkout, or create financial transactions. Users authenticate through OAuth and invoke certified quantitative operations using their existing MUSITU Axiom entitlement.
step_4_listing.categories_note: Confirm exact portal category enum at submission; choose one to five relevant categories only.
step_4_listing.slug_note: Permanent once published; verify availability and approve in portal before final submission.

primary: Investment appraisal and quantitative finance calculations without trade execution.
Risk, statistics, time-series, and scenario analysis.
Optimization and numerical analysis for decision-support workflows.
Independent calculation verification and reproducible quantitative checks.
step_5_use_cases.prerequisites: An existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement is required for authenticated compute.
step_5_use_cases.internal_state_note: The service records bounded entitlement, metering, OAuth, security, and audit state.

step_7_authentication.registration: Dynamic Client Registration supported; Claude published identity can be tested in the real custom connector flow.

step_8_data_handling.conversation_collection: Only operation arguments intentionally sent to the connector; the connector does not request full Claude conversation history.
step_8_data_handling.third_party_infrastructure: Cloudflare and the private compute hosting layer are used to operate the service.
